card.name: Second half of water-themed compounds
card.fires_on: The second part of a compound or noun phrase whose first part is a sea, water or coastal word, such as boat, sea, swim, seabed, fishing or aquatic. It fires on the noun that completes the phrase.

modes.label: Sea-word compounds
modes.description: A noun that follows sea, boat, swim or seabed and completes a marine term.

modes.label: Aquatic or coastal habitat nouns
modes.description: A noun after aquatic, fishing, salt or Atlantic that names a plant, place or habitat near water.
modes.example: Submerged aquatic<< plant>> having narrow leaves and small flowers.

card.writes: It nudges the output toward water-related words such as aquatic, underwater and waters.
card.plain: It lights up on the last word of a phrase about the sea or water, like seabed mining or fishing village.
